summary_en: This study tests four digital components to encourage HPV vaccination among U.S. Vietnamese parents of adolescents who have not started the vaccine, with the aim of reducing HPV-related cancers. Parents receive 0 to 4 components, delivered through a study website as videos and an online task, and the motivational interviewing component includes two phone or Zoom calls with a trained health educator; overall duration is not stated. The main outcome is the feasibility and acceptability of each component, and the phase is listed as NA in this pilot optimization trial.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa cuatro componentes digitales para animar a padres vietnamita-estadounidenses de adolescentes que aún no han iniciado la vacuna contra el VPH, con el objetivo de reducir los cánceres relacionados con el VPH. Los padres reciben entre 0 y 4 componentes, que se entregan por un sitio web del estudio en forma de videos y una tarea en línea, y el componente de entrevista motivacional incluye dos llamadas telefónicas o por Zoom con un educador de salud capacitado; la duración total no se indica. El resultado principal es la factibilidad y aceptabilidad de cada componente, y la fase figura como NA en este ensayo piloto de optimización.
who_for: Parent of a youth aged 9 to 18 who has not started the HPV vaccine series
Lived in the U.S. for 12 months or more
Only one parent per household can participate
not_for: Planning to move out of the U.S. within the next 6 months
Not fluent in spoken and written Vietnamese or spoken and written English
